system.description:
Once per Combat Turn, after a successful Strike on an enemy, you may make a second Strike at once. If that also succeeds, make a third Strike that deals double damage.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.35
system.summary: Once per Combat Turn, after a successful Strike on an enemy, you may make a second Strike at once. If that also succeeds, make a third Strike that deals double damage.

automation.note: Use once per Combat Turn after a Strike hits. The second Strike is a normal Strike. If it hits, roll the third in Chained Strike mode for double damage. Neither extra Strike costs an Action.
